messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage A:
"""
After the expiry of Moratorium Period no health insurance policy shall be contestable except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions specified in the policy contract. 13 Your Obligations Please disclose all pre-existing disease/s or condition/s before buying a policy. Non-disclosure may affect the claim settlement. Disclosure of other material information during the policy period.) Insurer to specify the material information Declaration by the Policy Holder; I have read the above and confirm having noted the details. Place: Date: (Signature of the Policyholder) Note: i. Insurer shall provide web-link where the product related documents including the Customer Information sheet are available on the website of the insurer. ii. In case of any conflict, the terms and conditions mentioned in the policy document shall prevail. iii. Insurer to take confirmation of the policyholder regarding receiving of the Customer Information Sheet.
"""

Passage B:
"""
We undertake to file the product afresh if there is any variation in the product filed above. Signature of the Chief Compliance Officer Place Date: Name and Counter Signature of the principal officer along with name, and Company’s seal. Annexure-5 Information to be furnished to IRDAI on Withdrawal of Health Insurance Products or Add-ons or Riders Offered by Life or Health or General Insurers GENERAL INSTRUCTIONS: (a) Insurers shall use the specified form for filing information about withdrawal of existing Health Insurance products or Add-ons or Riders. Format shall be used separately for each Product or Add-on or Rider. (b) All items in the Form must be furnished with the relevant details. (c) The form shall be filed within 30 days from the date of withdrawing the product. FORM:
"""

Write ONE question whose full answer needs a fact from Passage A AND a fact from Passage B (e.g. combine two rules, or apply one rule to the situation in the other). If no natural question needs both, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts_a": [1-3 word-for-word spans from A], "facts_b": [1-3 word-for-word spans from B], "sub_queries": [a short search query for A's fact, a short search query for B's fact]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"If a policyholder discloses a pre‑existing condition before buying a health insurance policy and the insurer later withdraws that product, can the insurer contest the claim within 30 days of the withdrawal?","answer":"No. The insurer must file the withdrawal within 30 days, but once the policy is withdrawn the insurer cannot contest a claim on the basis of the pre‑existing condition disclosed before the policy was issued.","facts_a":["Please disclose all pre-existing disease/s or condition/s before buying a policy.","After the expiry of Moratorium Period no health insurance policy shall be contestable except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions specified in the policy contract."],"facts_b":["The form shall be filed within 30 days from the date of withdrawing the product."],"sub_queries":["\"disclose all pre-existing disease\"","\"30 days from the date of withdrawing the product\""]}]}
